# DEXM Labs

> Small free browser games and makes from a home lab in the UK: Skywave, a daily ham radio propagation puzzle, Lorenz, a daily cipher machine puzzle, Tolerance, a daily engineering puzzle, Vector air traffic control, Orbit satellite missions, an Enigma machine simulator, a Chernobyl RBMK reactor simulator, an Apollo lunar landing game, and 3D print designs for the radio bench.

## Home

- [DEXM Labs](https://dexmlabs.app/): Homepage with the games and the makes.

## Games

- [Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/): A daily HF propagation puzzle on a 3D globe. Work ten made up stations in one UTC day. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/help.html): The rules of the daily Skywave puzzle.
- [Who made Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/about.html): Who made Skywave and why.
- [What's changed in Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/log.html): The Skywave change log.
- [Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/): A daily puzzle on the Lorenz SZ40/42 cipher machine that Bletchley Park called Tunny. Set the twelve wheels and read the intercept. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/help.html): The rules of the daily Lorenz puzzle.
- [Why I built Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/about.html): Why I built Lorenz.
- [What's changed in Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/log.html): The Lorenz change log.
- [Enigma Machine Simulator](https://dexmlabs.app/enigma-machine/): A historically accurate Enigma I simulator with a daily code breaking puzzle. Rotors I to V, reflector B, rings, plugboard and double stepping. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [Chernobyl Reactor Simulator](https://dexmlabs.app/chernobyl-reactor-simulator/): A simplified RBMK-1000 reactor simulator game with daily scenarios: control rods, graphite tips, the void coefficient, xenon and AZ-5. A game, not a training tool.
- [Apollo Lunar Landing Game](https://dexmlabs.app/apollo-lunar-landing-game/): Land the Apollo lunar module with real lunar gravity, engine thrust and fuel use. A new landing site every day. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [Booster Landing Game](https://dexmlabs.app/booster-landing-game/): A fan-made game. Land a slim DEXM Labs booster on a drone ship at sea with throttle, engine gimbal, thrusters, grid fins and landing legs, through wind gusts and a pitching, heaving deck, or catch a giant stainless steel booster with the launch tower arms. Seven levels, a five second replay. Independent and fan-made. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [Docking Run](https://dexmlabs.app/docking-run-game/): A space station docking game. Fly a crew capsule onto a docking port with 6DOF rigid body physics, RCS thrusters at real positions, Clohessy-Wiltshire orbital mechanics, time warp and real docking limits. Five runs from a 30 m final approach to a 2 km rendezvous and a night pass. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [Glider Thermals Game](https://dexmlabs.app/glider-thermals-game/): Fly a sailplane with a realistic glide polar, stall and speed to fly. Thermals under cumulus with circling birds, ridge lift and mountain wave, a vario that beeps as you climb, cross country routes with turnpoints and landing out in a field. Seven flights, autotrim assist, and a Daily Drop task.
- [Helicopter Sling Load Game](https://dexmlabs.app/helicopter-sling-load-game/): Fly a heavy lift helicopter with a load on a rope, with real pendulum physics, downwash and wind. Seven jobs from a first crate to a rooftop AC unit, a forest log, a fire bucket and a bridge span, graded S to D, plus a Daily Drop. Free, no account.
- [Tolerance](https://dexmlabs.app/tolerance/): A daily engineering puzzle. One mechanism, six guesses at the output, each one higher, lower or within 5%. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [MMX mission explained: interactive simulation](https://dexmlabs.app/missions/mmx/): Mission Replays: a time slider through JAXA's MMX mission to Phobos, from the H3 launch on 20 October 2026 to the planned sample return in 2031, with a heliocentric view and a Mars and Phobos close view.

## Makes

- [3D models](https://dexmlabs.app/makes/): Gallery of my 32 printable 3D models, grouped by collection, each linking to its Cults3D page.
- [Moon Rocket Cutaway](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/moon-rocket-cutaway-desk-model-saturn-v-style): My Saturn V style rocket stands about 300 mm tall. The stages lift apart and a window down the front shows the fuel tanks, the engines and the little lunar lander tucked inside. On Cults3D.
- [Space Shuttle Stack Cutaway](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/space-shuttle-stack-cutaway-desk-model-space-shuttle-style): The orbiter, the big tank and both boosters on one stand. I cut a window in the tank so you can see the two propellant tanks, and the payload bay opens. On Cults3D.
- [First Satellite](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/first-satellite-desk-model-sputnik-style): A polished Sputnik style sphere with its four swept antennas, held nose up on a round stand. I added a cutaway half if you want to see inside. On Cults3D.
- [Deep Space Probe](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/deep-space-probe-desk-model-voyager-style): My Voyager style probe, with the big dish, the golden record and the scan platform out on its boom. On Cults3D.
- [Lunar Lander](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/lunar-lander-desk-model-apollo-era-style): An Apollo era lander with the ascent stage sitting on the gold descent stage, ladder and all. On Cults3D.
- [Lunar Rover](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/lunar-rover-desk-model-apollo-era-style): The moon buggy to park next to my lander, with the seats, the antennas and the big wheels. On Cults3D.
- [Radar Desk Bundle](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/radar-desk-bundle-radar-station-desk-model-and-radar-scope-desk-console-with-di): My radar station and my radar scope console together on one matching display tray. A desk set for anyone who tracks aircraft at home. On Cults3D.
- [Air Defence Radar Station](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/air-defence-radar-station-desk-model-cold-war-style): A Cold War style radar site with the big dish and the height finder. There is an option to make the dish turn with a small motor. On Cults3D.
- [1090 MHz Ground Plane Hub](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/1090-mhz-adsb-ground-plane-antenna-hub-for-so239-n-chassis-sockets-parametric): The hub I use to build a quick aircraft band ground plane antenna on an SO239 or N socket. Free to print. On Cults3D.
- [Mast Coax Clip](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/ads-b-piaware-mast-coax-strain-relief-clip-20-25-32-mm-pole-5-mm-sma-pigta): A small clip that takes the strain off the coax at the top of my receiver mast. Sizes for 20, 25 and 32 mm poles. On Cults3D.
- [RTL SDR Desk Cradle and Pi Mount Pack](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/rtl-sdr-desk-cradle-pi-4-5-mount-pack-ads-b-dump1090-sma-strain-relief): I got tired of my SDR dongle dangling off the Pi, so I made a desk cradle and mounts that hold it all tidy with strain relief on the SMA. On Cults3D.
- [SMA Dust Caps](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/sma-dust-caps-for-sdr-dongles-lnas-female-male-tethered-fit-test-strip): Tethered caps for the SMA ports on my dongles and LNAs, with a fit test strip so you get them snug first time. Free. On Cults3D.
- [Cipher Set](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/cipher-set-field-cipher-machine-rotor-and-lorenz-demonstrators-with-display-pl): Three of my cipher models together on one display plinth: the field cipher machine, the rotor demonstrator and the Lorenz wheel. On Cults3D.
- [Field Cipher Machine](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/field-cipher-machine-desk-model-enigma-style): An Enigma style desk model in its wooden box, with the keyboard, the lampboard and the rotor thumbwheels. On Cults3D.
- [Three Rotor Cipher Demonstrator](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/three-rotor-cipher-demonstrator-enigma-style-teaching-model): A teaching model with three turning rotors so you can trace a letter by hand and see how a rotor machine scrambles it. Free. On Cults3D.
- [WinWing MCDU and FCU Desk Stand Kit](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/desk-stand-kit-for-winwing-winctrl-mcdu-32-and-fcu-tilt-stand-fcu-feet-des): Tilt stands, feet and a desk clamp for the WinCTRL MCDU and FCU, so my sim panels sit at the right angle. On Cults3D.
- [WinWing Hole Fit Templates](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/hole-fit-templates-for-winwing-winctrl-mcdu-32-and-fcu-free): Thin templates to check the cut outs before you drill a sim panel. Free. On Cults3D.
- [iPad mini Kneeboard](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/kneeboard-for-ipad-mini-6-and-ipad-mini-a17-pro-slide-in-pilot-efb-holder-wi): A slide in kneeboard for the iPad mini 6 and the A17 Pro, for charts and checklists on my knee. On Cults3D.
- [Servo Robot Arm Kit](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/servo-robot-arm-kit-desk-arm-with-fork-gripper-mg996r-and-sg90): A desk robot arm with a fork gripper, built around MG996R and SG90 servos. On Cults3D.
- [Royal Game of Ur Desk Set](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/royal-game-of-ur-desk-set-with-board-pieces-and-tetrahedral-dice): The oldest board game I know of, with the board, the pieces and proper four sided dice. On Cults3D.
- [Angular Grip for Playdate](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/angular-grip-compatible-with-playdate-slide-in-crank-side-kept-clear-paramet): A slide in grip that makes the Playdate nicer to hold for long sessions and keeps the crank side clear. On Cults3D.
- [RBMK Reactor Cutaway](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/rbmk-reactor-cutaway-desk-model-educational): My cutaway of an RBMK core. Lift the lid to see the fuel channel grid, the graphite stack and the control rods. It goes with my reactor game. On Cults3D.
- [Bobbin Boo Halloween](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/art/bobbin-boo-halloween-multi-part-no-ams-3mf): A friendly little Halloween ghost in a few parts, so you get the colours without a multi colour printer. On Cults3D.
- [Tinsel Buns Christmas Ornaments](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/home/tinsel-buns-christmas-ornaments-multi-part-no-ams-3mf): Christmas tree ornaments in separate colour parts that fit together. No multi colour printer needed. On Cults3D.
- [Double Helix Bolt](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/double-helix-bolt-left-and-right-hand-threads-on-one-shank-two-nuts-parametr): One shank with a left hand and a right hand thread on it, and two nuts that run in opposite directions. A great fidget. On Cults3D.
- [Tusi Couple Desk Toy](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/tusi-couple-gears-that-move-in-straight-lines-desk-toy-parametric): Gears that turn in circles yet move a point in a straight line. I could watch it all day. On Cults3D.
- [Pickleball Waistband Holder](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/pickleball-waistband-holder-snap-in-cage-for-1-or-2-balls-parametric): A snap in cage that clips on your waistband and holds one or two balls. Free. On Cults3D.
- [Stall Bar Bridle Hook](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/home/clip-on-bridle-and-halter-hook-for-stall-grille-bars-no-screws-7-8-in-and-1-i): A hook that clips onto stable grille bars to hang a bridle or halter, with no screws. On Cults3D.
- [Radar Scope Desk Console](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/radar-scope-desk-console-for-round-raspberry-pi-displays-for-waveshare-5in-and): 3D print housing that turns a round Raspberry Pi display into a retro radar scope for an ADS-B receiver. Fits the Waveshare 5 inch and 4 inch round screens. On Cults3D.
- [Lorenz chi wheel](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/lorenz-cipher-chi-wheel-demonstrator-simplified-sz42-teaching-model): 3D print of a simplified SZ42 chi wheel, for showing how Lorenz works. On Cults3D.
- [EFHW toroid box](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/toroid-box-for-ft240-and-ft140-cores-efhw-49-1-9-1-unun-choke-so-239-n-or): 3D print for FT240 and FT140 cores. On Cults3D.
- [RF panel drill guide](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/rf-connector-panel-drill-guides-so-239-n-4-hole-flange-and-bnc-d-hole-with): 3D print for SO-239, N and BNC holes. On Cults3D.
- [Band plan desk mat](https://arthurdeusexmachina-shop.fourthwall.com/products/uk-ham-radio-band-plan-desk-mat-160m-to-70cm): UK ham bands, 160m to 70cm. On Fourthwall.
- [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/arthurdeusexmachina): Support the lab.

## Daily puzzle

- [Today's Puzzle](https://dexmlabs.app/puzzle/): One small puzzle a day, by UK date: a rotor cipher, a Morse riddle, an aviation question or a physics and space question. Points and streak stay in your browser.

## Hire me

- [Hire me](https://dexmlabs.app/hire/): Software development for hire: full stack React, C#, Python, SQL, APIs, automation, AI integrations, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, websites and 3D design for printing.

## Points

- [How points work](https://dexmlabs.app/points/): Points are earned in the daily games and spent on hints. They stay in your browser.
